```
(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A battery assembly comprising: an enclosure; a first battery cell positioned within the enclosure; and a first sensor positioned within the enclosure for detecting at least one force influencing the first battery cell, __wherein the first sensor is a non-contact sensor configured to detect mechanical stress without being in direct contact with the first battery cell__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell, __wherein the first sensor is a non-contact sensor configured to detect mechanical stress without being in direct contact with the first battery cell__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising: a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell; a third battery cell stacked on top of the second battery cell; and a second sensor positioned between the third battery cell and the second battery cell for detecting at least one force influencing the third battery cell, __wherein at least one of the first sensor and the second sensor is a non-contact sensor configured to detect mechanical stress without being in direct contact with the first battery cell or the second battery cell__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises: __a non-contact force sensor__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 26: The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises a pressure sensitive ink, __wherein the pressure sensitive ink is configured to operate without requiring direct contact with the first battery cell__.
```
